name: Attractor pattern
description: Copies a body over a face. Each copy is scaled, sunk, turned and coloured by its distance to attractors.

body.title: Body to copy
body.description: Its name. Model it at the origin, standing on XY and pointing up Z, or give its frame below.

face_body.title: Body with the face
face_body.description: The body that owns the face to pattern on.

face.title: Face
face.description: A point on the face, as x, y, z, or the face's name from model.faces. Planar and cylindrical faces only.

attractor_points.title: Attractor points
attractor_points.description: x, y, z; x, y, z; ...

attractor_lines.title: Attractor lines
attractor_lines.description: x, y, z to x, y, z; ...

attractor_edges.title: Attractor edges
attractor_edges.description: Body @ x, y, z on the edge; ...

attractor_faces.title: Attractor faces
attractor_faces.description: Body @ x, y, z on the face, or Body @ face name; ...

u_count.title: U count
u_count.description: About how many copies across the face.

v_count.title: V count
v_count.description: About how many copies along the face.

seed.title: Random seed
seed.description: Random grids: the same seed gives the same layout.

grid_rotation.title: Grid rotation
grid_rotation.description: Turns the grid on the face.

border.title: Border
border.description: Drops points closer than this to the face's edges.

scale_near.title: Scale near
scale_near.description: Scale of the copy nearest an attractor.

scale_near_xyz.title: Scale near x, y, z
scale_near_xyz.description: Per-axis scale nearest; overrides Scale near.

scale_far_xyz.title: Scale far x, y, z
scale_far_xyz.description: Per-axis scale farthest; overrides Scale far.

depth_near.title: Depth near
depth_near.description: How far the nearest copy sinks into the face; negative lifts it.

depth_far.title: Depth far
depth_far.description: How far the farthest copy sinks.

rotation_axis.title: Rotation axis
rotation_axis.description: The body's axis to turn about.

color_near.title: Colour near
color_near.description: #rrggbb, r, g, b or hsl(h, s, l).

color_far.title: Colour far
color_far.description: #rrggbb, r, g, b or hsl(h, s, l).

range_near.title: Range near
range_near.description: Distances up to this count as near. Set both ends or neither.

range_far.title: Range far
range_far.description: Distances from this on count as far.

cutoff.title: Cutoff
cutoff.description: Drops copies farther than this from every attractor.

waves.title: Waves
waves.description: Wave falloff: how many waves over the distances.

decay.title: Wave decay
decay.description: The wave's height shrinks 100-fold every this many mm.

merge_scope.title: Merge with
merge_scope.description: Bodies to join, cut or intersect with; default every other visible body.

keep_input.title: Keep the body
keep_input.description: Keep the body that was copied.

levels.title: Steps
levels.description: How many steps scale and colour take from near to far. Each costs up to three of the 256 calls a run may make.

flip_body.title: Flip the body
flip_body.description: Turn the body over before placing it.

flip_normal.title: Flip the face normal
flip_normal.description: Copies stand on the other side; use it for holes.

body_origin.title: Body origin
body_origin.description: x, y, z: the point of the body that goes onto the face.

body_z.title: Body up
body_z.description: x, y, z: the body's direction that follows the face normal.

body_x.title: Body x
body_x.description: x, y, z: the body's direction that follows the grid.
